operations.title: Resolved polarization-contraction circuits admit a canonical cyclic monoidal augmentation to the scalar line.
The resolved tree counit has a canonical cyclic all-topology strictly Cut-monoidal lift on the universal surface-presentation complex.
Cut-equation conservativity and ultraviolet boundary data uniquely descend the universal counit to mapping-class-invariant canonical surface functions at arbitrary topology.
The resolved surface counit closes coefficientwise on the once-punctured torus and commutes with nonseparating Cut only when circuits are evaluated after cutting.
The complete marked-handle Yang–Mills leading singularity equals the resolved curve-cover polynomial including longitudinal projector corrections.
The marked-handle identity is symbolic, flip-natural, Cut-strict before circuit evaluation, and mapping-class equivariant.
Null on-shell momentum alone does not make physical-projector sewing reference independent in arbitrary graph environments.
Aligned Ward quotient closure is reference independent and two closures satisfy trace interchange on the tested marked-theta rank-four tensor.
Physical/curve realization does not commute on raw cubic-origin labels or endpointwise partial sums.
Graph addition has strictly functorial cellular transition maps on a finite graph-multiplihedral sewing-stage carrier.
After propagator composition and even endpoint gluing, the closed sector of the local Ward complex is ordinary graph homology.
Marked edge deletion is well defined, order preserving, dimension nonincreasing, relabeling covariant, and strictly functorial on marked tubings.
The additive Ward-to-circuit problem is solved integrally by retaining the nonsplit two-term circuit resolution.
For K2m, graph homology is A_(m-1) and cyclic road circuits form a canonical nonsplit dihedral resolution.
The circuit resolution is the augmented cellular complex of the road polygon, with rational Green split and integral Jacobian obstruction Z/m.
Prescribed-divergence transport is a homology torsor and failure of a Green section to commute with Cut is a harmonic cocycle.
The two six-point polarity tripods glue integrally and equivariantly to K2,3, transgressing the QTDS contact difference to the Ward circuit.
K2,m supplies an exact abstract suspension skeleton, while scalar-normal realization beyond m=3 remains conditional.
Alternating scalar-scaffold fusion residues canonically derive the six-point QTDS contact matrix and marked-theta Ward-kernel lift as an integral coefficient symbol.
Higher scalar polarity carriers are not canonically global K2,m graphs indexed by arity; exact-core fibers split regionally from eight points onward.
The scalar master carries a stratified diagram of connected regional polarity fibers rather than one global suspension graph.
The eight-point rank-at-most-two carrier has homotopy type K2,12 on quadrangulation roads, distinct from the Möbius compatibility carrier.
All sixteen transverse eight-point coefficient-valued marked-Cut squares close exactly.
Regional occurrence data do not canonically determine a weight-preserving same-core scalar-edge transport on nontransverse pentagons.
Common-label incidence spans and two-stage saturated Čech descent reconstruct every rank-eight full-core fiber without endpoint transport.
Nontransverse coefficients separate into a constructible source cosheaf and an exact fixed-core cubical target carrier.
Construct the degree-shifted finite-alpha-prime loaded Gysin chain map from route faces into the fixed-core cube, including quotient lower terms, caps, orientations, and deck orbit.
